fawry_taqseet.name: My Fawry Taqseet / ماي فوري تقسيط

facts.arabic: فتح المحفظة مجاني تمامًا بـ 0 جنيه رسوم اشتراك.
facts.english: Opening the wallet has no subscription fee: 0 EGP.

facts.arabic: التفعيل لحظي عند إيداع 20 جنيه كحد أدنى لحساب العميل.
facts.english: Activation is immediate upon depositing a minimum of 20 EGP into the customer account.

facts.arabic: إيداع مبلغ 20 جنيه مصري كحد أدنى (يستقر في رصيد العميل).
facts.english: The initial AXIS Pay deposit of at least EGP 20 remains in the customer’s balance.

facts.arabic:
تفعيل QNB Wallet يكون لحظيًا بشرط إيداع حد أدنى:

**20 جنيه**
facts.english: QNB Wallet activation is immediate provided the customer deposits at least 20 EGP.
Open the MyFawry app.
Enter the wallet.
Select My Savings.
Select Add Fund.
Follow the registration steps.

facts.arabic: وزيارة أقرب فرع فوري بلس عند توجيه التطبيق للعميل.
facts.english: Visit the nearest Fawry Plus branch when the application directs the customer to do so.
A valid national ID is required.
The mobile number must be registered in the customer name.

facts.arabic: وألا يكون على الرقم أي محفظة أخرى.
facts.english: No other wallet may already be linked to that mobile number.

facts.arabic: محفظة QNB Wallet — السحب النقدي من ATM: 1% من المبلغ بحد أدنى 4 جنيه.
facts.english: QNB Wallet ATM withdrawals cost 1% of the amount, with a minimum of 4 EGP.
Deposits through Fawry Plus cost 1% of the deposited amount.
Deposits through ATMs are free.
Check that the national ID is valid and original.
